## 2.4.3.4.Health and Wellness:

- In terms of the management of health and safety it is often thesafetyclement that gets most attentionas its outcomes aremainly certain and immediate.Beyond Zero is about preventing injury and ill-health to cvcryonc and itisthcreforeimportant thatweensurepcrsonnelwhoareengaged to undertake the Works are assessed as fit-to-work and that any pre-existing health conditions or concerns are identified before that person is put to work.
- In carrying out their work, staff and workers could be exposed to activities that may harm and damage their health; this harm may be either acute or chronic.
- Exposure to thefollowing is likely to be harmful to health:
- ?Noise - noise induced hearing loss
- Vibration - hand arm vibration, whole body vibration
- Manualhandling-musculoskeletaldisorders
- Hazardous substances - poisoning, respiratory illness, dermatitis etc.
- Working in extreme summer temperatures -- heat exhaustion, heat stroke
- Drugs and alcohol -- increased likelihood of having, causing accidents, lack of concentration, mood swings etc.
- In order to prevent harm occuring risk assessments must include how the health of staffand workeis may be harmed and suitable control measures are to be implemented to prevent this harn.
